name: Umkhonto Wealth
description: Investing in your future, on and off the track.
story: Umkhonto Wealth is a leading South African investment firm dedicated to empowering individuals and businesses. Recognizing the parallels between precision finance and high-performance motorsport, they sponsor teams that demonstrate strategic thinking, calculated risk-taking, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. They seek to build brand awareness internationally and identify potential new investment opportunities within the motorsport industry.
